items.detail_en: An interview with Principal Jiang Shu-fang.
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」校長專訪系列。

footnote_en: Everything takes place in the school library. Our contact is the English teacher, Ms. Jiang Ying-xue (江映雪老師). In the morning, Dom is at Yuying Elementary.
footnote_zh: 全部在學校圖書室進行。聯絡窗口是英文老師江映雪老師。當天上午 Dom 在育英國小。
